benefits.intro: E-invoicing thresholds, wave numbers, and go-live dates change constantly — often with little public notice. Subscribe once, and every government update or announcement across the 33 jurisdictions we track lands in your inbox automatically, in plain language, before it catches your team off guard.

item1.body: Every new mandate, shifted deadline, and penalty change we track, written in plain language — not legal text copy-pasted from a tax authority's press release.
item1.title: Real government announcements, summarised

item2.body: Tell us which of the 33 jurisdictions matter to your business, and your monthly notification email tells you specifically whether they came up — or get the full global digest if you'd rather see everything.
item2.title: Choose exactly which countries you care about

item3.body: Every past issue lives in a searchable, filterable archive — look back at any month, any country, any time, not just whatever landed in your inbox most recently.
item3.title: A full, searchable back-catalogue

item4.body: New country deep dives and education guides get flagged to subscribers first, as we publish them.
item4.title: Priority access to new education content
